subject: Demo: adjust schedule for CTO layover & VP standby coverage
messages:
From: Alex Harper <alex.harper@acme.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Casey Liu <casey.liu@acme.com>, Sarah Contracts <sarah.contracts@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — quick ask about timing

Hey Mina,

Quick update: I'm flying through SFO on Monday 6/21 and have a ~90 minute layover between inbound and an onward flight. I'd like to join the demo if possible but only have the layover window 10:30–12:00 PDT.

Casey and I very much want your team to present the end-to-end routing and cost controls — if we can compress the demo or split into a 30–40 minute exec highlight + a deeper technical session later that would work. Sarah, procurement wants the basic SSO/SLA answers up front.

Can you propose a plan that allows me to join briefly and not derail the broader agenda? If not, what's the best fallback so the deal momentum doesn't stall?

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.
Alex

--
Alex Harper
CTO, Acme Corp
alex.harper@acme.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@acme.com>
Cc: Casey Liu <casey.liu@acme.com>, Sarah Contracts <sarah.contracts@acme.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — quick ask about timing

Alex — great to hear you can join, even briefly. We can absolutely accommodate a two-part flow: a 30–35 minute "exec highlight" focused on business outcomes, latency/SLA guarantees, and the routing/rollback policy while you're on the layover, followed by a deeper 60–75 minute technical walk-through later in the week for Casey's engineering team.

Proposed plan: 
- Monday 6/21 10:30–11:05 PDT: Exec highlight (Kimberly from our side + you).
- Wednesday 6/23 10:00–11:15 PDT: Full technical deep-dive (Karthik + eng team).

Logistics: we'll compress the deck for a single-slide SLA + one slide with a short demo clip (15–20s streaming sample) to keep the exec session tight. We'll record the deep-dive and share the recording and the short exec deck.

I copied Kimberly and Karthik to confirm availability and coverage. Sarah — we'll make sure procurement Qs are covered in the exec highlight and follow with any contractual details in writing and a separate brief with legal if needed.

Attachments: trimmed exec deck (Acme-demo-deck-v2.pdf) and your flight layover (CTO-itinerary-layover.pdf) — trying to align everyone's expectations.

If that looks good I'll rebook the calendar and send updated invites.

Best,
Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Harper <alex.harper@acme.com>, Casey Liu <casey.liu@acme.com>, Sarah Contracts <sarah.contracts@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 07:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Coverage plan for Acme demo — CTO layover 10:30–11:05 PDT

Team — heads-up, Alex (CTO) is on a short SFO layover and can join 10:30–11:05 PDT today. Goal is to get an exec-level confirmation on routing policies, SLOs, and pricing impact.

Ask: can Kimberly take the 10:30–11:05 exec slot and cover procurement questions (session will be short and focused)? Karthik — if we compress the demo to the two key flows (routing fallback + quantization/cost examples) do you have a 2–3 slide boil-down we can use? Vanessa — be on standby to own recording + follow-up notes and to send the deep-dive calendar link.

Proposed micro-agenda (10:30–11:05):
- 10:30 quick hello (1–2 min)
- 10:32 SLA & routing policy (5 min)
- 10:37 Sizing/cost picture + quick live clip (8 min)
- 10:45 Procurement Qs + next steps (10 min)
- 10:55 Confirm deep-dive time & close (10 min)

I will keep Alex, Casey, and Sarah copied so they see the plan. If Kimberly or Karthik can't make it, flag now and I'll propose an alternative.

Thanks — Mina
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Harper <alex.harper@acme.com>, Casey Liu <casey.liu@acme.com>, Sarah Contracts <sarah.contracts@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 07:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Coverage plan for Acme demo — CTO layover 10:30–11:05 PDT

All good — I can take the exec slot. Karthik, I reviewed the proposed ticks; if you send the two slides (SLA + cost-profile) in the next 30 minutes I'll incorporate them into the trimmed deck. Vanessa, please make sure we have a 1-slide procurement FAQ that answers: data residency, retention, audit logs, and breach notification SLA. Mina, I'll lead the 10:30 session and hand off to Karthik for the Wednesday deep-dive.

I'll also ask Legal to prepare a short summary for Sarah to expedite procurement review — copying in Joel from Legal is fine? (Joel is on legal@redwood.ai)

Kimberly Park
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@acme.com>, Casey Liu <casey.liu@acme.com>, Sarah Contracts <sarah.contracts@acme.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 17:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Exec highlight today 10:30–11:05 PDT + technical deep-dive Wed 6/23 10:00 PDT

Thanks for the quick coordination. Confirming:
- Exec highlight: Monday 6/21, 10:30–11:05 PDT (Kimberly hosting). We'll run the shortened deck, cover routing and SLA, and answer procurement Qs.
- Tech deep-dive: Wednesday 6/23, 10:00–11:15 PDT (Karthik + eng). We'll record and share notes.

Attachments: final trimmed exec deck (Acme-demo-deck-v2.pdf) attached; Vanessa will post the recording and slides after each session.

Next steps: I'll send updated calendar invites and an internal run-through invite for Kimberly/Karthik at 9:30 PDT today for quick sync. Sarah — if you want the legal summary before the exec highlight I can loop Joel from Legal now.

Appreciate the flexibility and looking forward to today's session.

Best,
Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
